joel: Heads-up, my docs PR for embeddings is blocked by a runtime question. I added an example that treats items as nested arrays for grouping, reviewers flagged it. Can runtime confirm allowed shapes?

ci-bot: Preview: https://deploy-preview-721.docs.redwood.ai (checks in progress)

rhea: Runtime expects the request body to be items: [item, item, ...]. Each item may be either a string or an array of strings. If it's an array of strings we join parts with a single ASCII space to form one text and return one embedding per item.

joel: So nested arrays (arrays of arrays inside an item) are invalid?

rhea: Correct. We do NOT accept nested arrays beyond the allowed array-of-strings per item. Posting nested arrays will return 422. Use this exact example response for docs: {"error":"unsupported input shape: nested arrays not accepted; each item must be a string or array of strings","status":422}

joel: Thanks. Another edgecase: what if after join the combined text is empty? Previously some clients got back an empty vector.

rhea: That's been changed. If the final text is empty we return 400. Example response: {"error":"empty input","status":400}. Please include guidance in docs recommending caller-side normalization (strip/trimming) if they want to avoid that.

joel: Also, how do we handle leading/trailing whitespace and punctuation when joining parts? reviewers wanted explicit wording.

rhea: We preserve each part's whitespace exactly, then insert a single ASCII space between parts. So ["Hi ", "there"] -> "Hi  there" (double space preserved). Punctuation is not stripped. If you want normalized text show a snippet using .strip() or regex.

joel: Great. I'll remove the nested-array example and add two error examples and a short note on whitespace. Pushing update now.

deploy-bot: Preview redeployed for PR 721: https://deploy-preview-721.docs.redwood.ai (:white_check_mark:)

ci-bot: All checks green.

rhea: Reviewed, one tiny wording nit only. Removing hold.

joel: Merged after CI. Thanks everyone!
